title: DiarHaidary/Nelson-Nguyen-conjecture-upper-bound-palomar
abstract: Lean 4 formalization of three sparse oblivious-subspace-embedding results at the Nelson--Nguyen parameter scale: the fully independent signed-hash SparseStack construction, independent uniform signed exact-s columns, and a limited-independence transfer for finite laws whose combined hash-sign selector marginals agree with SparseStack through order 4q.  At the stated rounded parameters the selected theorems give failure probability at most delta, with explicit strict bounds s < 1356 q / epsilon and m < 306456 (d + q) / epsilon^2 where those parameter conclusions are packaged.  The formalization is machine checked but has not been peer reviewed and makes no priority claim.
